blocks.text: Ten new queens will be crowned at the 2026 Mutya ng Pilipinas Grand Coronation Night at the Playtime FilOil Centre in San Juan City tonight, Oct. 14. The final competition will serve as a festive culmination of the two weeks since the official 37 delegates were announced for this year’s competition, the 58th anniversary celebration and 55th edition of the second longest-running national pageant in the Philippines. Miss Intercontinental fourth runner-up and Power of Beauty winner Christina Vanhefflin is set to relinquish her title as Mutya ng Pilipinas-Intercontinental to her successor at the end of the program.
